title: Transaction
description: A movement of funds on an account.

account.description: Account ID; expanded to an Account object when nested in a Collection (v4+).

amount.description: Transaction amount. Decimal serialised as a string, e.g. "3000.0000".

currency.description: Currency code (present on the nested transaction in Collection samples).

type.description: admin_funds_update, mobile_funds_update, funds_deposit, funds_adjustment, mobile_collection, mobile_payment, airtime_topup, service_charge, mobile_withdrawal or bank_withdrawal.

fee_transaction.description: Related fee transaction, if any (type not documented).
